description: This is a JUnit test class for the TenantClientImpl in the Eclipse Hono project, testing tenant retrieval, caching, and error handling.

classes.name: TenantClientImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating behavior of TenantClientImpl including caching, error handling, and request formation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, mocks dependencies, and creates instances for testing.

methods.name: testGetTenantInvokesServiceIfNoCacheConfigured
methods.description: Tests that the tenant retrieval calls the service when no cache is configured.

methods.name: testGetTenantAddsInfoToCacheOnCacheMiss
methods.description: Verifies that tenant information is added to cache upon a cache miss.

methods.name: testGetTenantReturnsValueFromCache
methods.description: Ensures tenant info is retrieved from cache when available.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsWithSendError
methods.description: Checks failure behavior when the sender queue is full.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsWithRejectedRequest
methods.description: Tests failure handling when the request is rejected by the service.

methods.name: testGetTenantByCaUsesRFC2253SubjectDn
methods.description: Verifies that a distinguished name (DN) is properly included in the request payload.

methods.name: testGetTenantIncludesRequiredInformationInRequest
methods.description: Ensures the request message contains tenant ID and necessary properties.
